scientific_integrity.evidence: A symbolic orbital-pair classification, an exact Gaussian coefficient calculation and a dominated-convergence proof of the two theta limits; the supplied enumerator checks six small models and selected rank formulas
limitations: Independent verification has not been performed
Full spectrum evaluation applies only to independent eventually periodic generators without mixed relations
Sharp theta limits hold for fixed prime period while the number of generators grows
Finite computations are supporting tests, not a proof of the infinite formulas
Broad Burnside group-subgroup structure and the Gaussian theta asymptotics have substantial prior foundations; historical priority for this explicit combination remains provisional
scientific_integrity.premise: The general orbital-pair K-theory splitting is taken from Sarazola–Shapiro–Zakharevich, arXiv:2611.05265v1, Theorem 3.15; this is not independently reproved

title: Orbital subgroup spectra and Gaussian–theta growth for independently periodic monoids
